PocketWorld Lepton static-library dependency notices
====================================================

This distribution uses the following Cargo.lock packages when building the
official Lepton 0.5.8 iOS ARM64 static library. Packages offering Apache-2.0
are distributed under that option; the complete Apache-2.0 text is included
as Lepton-LICENSE.txt. Packages requiring another notice are reproduced below.

Runtime packages linked for aarch64-apple-ios:

  adler2 2.0.1                         Apache-2.0
  bytemuck 1.25.2                      Apache-2.0
  byteorder 1.5.0                      MIT
  cfg-if 1.0.4                         Apache-2.0
  crc32fast 1.5.0                      Apache-2.0
  default-boxed 0.2.0                  MIT
  flate2 1.1.9                         Apache-2.0
  git-version 0.3.9                    BSD-2-Clause
  lepton_jpeg 0.5.8                    Apache-2.0
  log 0.4.33                           Apache-2.0
  miniz_oxide 0.8.9                    Apache-2.0
  safe_arch 0.9.3                      Apache-2.0
  simd-adler32 0.3.10                  MIT
  wide 0.8.3                           Apache-2.0

Build-time or non-iOS locked packages (not linked into the iOS binary) were
also checked: bitflags 2.13.1, cpu-time 1.0.0, default-boxed-derive 0.2.0,
git-version-macro 0.3.9, libc 0.2.189, proc-macro2 1.0.107, quote 1.0.47,
rustversion 1.0.23, syn 1.0.109, syn 2.0.119, thread-priority 1.2.0,
unicode-ident 1.0.24, winapi 0.3.9, winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu 0.4.0, and
winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu 0.4.0. Their Cargo metadata declares permissive
MIT, Apache-2.0, Unicode-3.0, or dual-license terms; none is copyleft.
